terminals.description: Read-only target-architecture decision cockpit (FastAPI) on http://127.0.0.1:8790. Needs no secrets. The main API (make dev, port 8788) is NOT auto-started because it hard-fails without DATABASE_URL + Supabase/Resend secrets by design (CLAUDE.md #1); set those secrets and run `make dev` to boot it.
